item.title: Joseph scores record-equalling five tries as England rout Japan
item.body: Will Joseph marked his return to the Test game after four years out with a record-equalling five tries as England tore through Japan.

caption:
🔴 BREAKING | 🏉 Joseph scores record-equalling five tries as England rout Japan

Will Joseph marked his return to the Test game after four years out with a record-equalling five tries as England tore through Japan.
